enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn onto left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn onto right side. Shift legs. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn onto back. Breathe deeply. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply soap. Rub face. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply shampoo. Rub scalp. Rinse hair. Apply body wash. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out milk. Take out butter. Close refrigerator. Take out pan from cabinet. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Put eggs on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Put bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Take out bread. Spread butter on bread. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut egg. Eat egg. Eat bread. Pick up kettle. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Press kettle switch. Wait for water to boil. Pour water into mug. Add coffee powder. Stir. Pick up mug. Drink coffee. Put down mug. Pick up plate. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Put dishes in sink. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, checking phone for shift messages, packing bag
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take off towel. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Press power button. Swipe screen. Open messaging app. Read messages. Type reply. Put down phone. Open bag. Put in laptop. Put in charger. Put in wallet. Put in keys. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Read news. Put phone away. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Adjust bag. Stand up. Walk to door. Thank driver. Step off bus. Cross street. Walk on sidewalk. Open clinic door. Step inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, seeing patients and updating medical records
enriched_activities.desc: Enter clinic. Greet colleagues. Put bag in locker. Put on lab coat. Wash hands. Pick up patient list. Call first patient. Escort patient to exam room. Ask about symptoms. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Prescribe medication. Type notes into computer. Call next patient. Repeat consultations. Update medical records. Take a short break. Drink water. Wash hands. Continue seeing patients. Update records. Organize files. Prepare for next shift.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Unwrap sandwich. Take out apple. Take out water bottle. Open water bottle. Drink water. Eat sandwich. Eat apple. Wipe mouth with napkin. Throw away trash. Close lunch bag. Wash hands. Return to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical work, patient consultations and charting
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient list. Call next patient. Escort to exam room. Review medical history. Ask about symptoms. Perform physical exam. Measure pulse. Check temperature. Prescribe treatment. Type notes. Update chart. Call next patient. Repeat consultations. Consult with colleague. Review lab results. Write prescriptions. Answer phone calls. Schedule follow-up appointments. Organize patient files. Wash hands. Prepare for end of shift.
Walk out of clinic. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Get off bus. Walk to home. Open front door. Step inside. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Take off work clothes. Put clothes in hamper. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply shampoo. Rub scalp. Rinse hair. Apply body wash. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to bedroom. Put on clean clothes.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Cut chicken. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add spices. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Sit down at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Put down fork. Pick up plate. Walk to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up dishes and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates into dishwasher. Load cups. Load utensils. Add detergent. Close dishwasher door. Press start button. Pick up sponge. Wipe counter. Wipe stove. Rinse sponge. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and browsing on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Open web browser. Browse internet. Read articles. Check email. Type reply. Close laptop. Put down laptop. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing a load of laundry with the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Open washing machine. Put dirty clothes in. Add detergent. Close washing machine door. Press start button. Wait for cycle. Open washing machine. Take out clothes. Put clothes in dryer. Close dryer door. Press start button. Wait for dryer. Open dryer. Take out clothes. Fold clothes. Put clothes away.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, watching TV and reading on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Pick up phone. Open reading app. Read article. Scroll. Read another article. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Lie down. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Nighttime hygiene routine, brushing teeth and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply soap. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Put down towel. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn onto left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn onto right side. Shift legs. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn onto back. Breathe deeply. Sleep.
